description: The right-hand plot in Figure 5 illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-3, plotted against the network layer. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” ranges from 0 to approximately 22 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” is linear and spans from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Three distinct lines are shown: a blue dashed line representing the “sparsity ratio before gate,” which remains near zero across all layers (average 0.003); an orange dotted line for the “sparsity ratio after gate,” which starts near 0.8 at layer 0 and rapidly declines to near zero by layer 10, with minor fluctuations afterward (average 0.126); and a green dash-dot line for the “sparsity ratio after average gate,” which begins near 0.7, drops sharply to below 0.1 by layer 5, and remains low with slight undulations (average 0.080).
